Seaborg named AEC chairman, succeeding John A. McCone (confirmed by Senate 24 Feb).' No end to the chairmanship is established by any record opened for this pass.

claims.text: The first Director was Roy W. Johnson, not Herbert York. A second agency's record dates the founding and names the officer independently: the CIA Historical Staff Chronology under Jan-Apr 58 reads '7 FEB. Advanced Research Projects Agency (ARPA) established in DOD, Roy W. Johnson of General Electric named director, responsible for US space program, including missiles and anti-missiles.' Herbert York was ARPA's first Chief Scientist and was later elevated to first Director of Defense Research and Engineering.

edges.label: Corresponded with the Director of Central Intelligence
edges.note: Dulles thanks him for a report on a Vienna conference and says he is circulating it inside the Agency. The edge records a documented channel between the AEC chair and the DCI, which is the board's own structural claim in miniature.

edges.label: Chairman of the Commission
edges.note: Named 16 January 1961 and confirmed by the Senate on 24 February 1961 per the CIA's own chronology; in office on Commission letterhead in October 1961 and March 1963. No end date is attested by any record opened here.

edges.label: Transmitted the Commission's annual report to the Director of Central Intelligence
edges.note: The 20 March 1963 letter forwards the Annual Report to Congress for 1962 to DCI John A. McCone and directs his attention to the appendix on environmental contamination from nuclear explosives.
